details.name: Da Pan
details.quote: Oh, we meet again, Endmin. Got an engineering problem? Point it out, and consider it fixed! And I'll be EVEN happier if there's canteen work for me!
details.infection: Oripathy negative, based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Cooking: Heat Control Skilleting, steaming, deep-frying, stir-frying, and stewing. Master the stove and you master the hundred arts of cooking. Da Pan will not hesitate to use his secret Huohou (art of stovefire) to perfectly balance the riot of flavors in his dishes.
details.exp2d: Tool Assembly: Mechanical Engineering When HAS professors bring along their teapots to discuss academic topics with Da Pan, the Tianshi disciples realize that the chef is also carrying a flask with a slogan that reads: "Vanguard Scientist."
details.hb1d: Lifestyle: Gourmet Chef Da Pan enjoys creating new dishes. But getting a heartfelt "DELICIOUS!" from his patrons will make him even happier.
details.hb2d: Charity: Worldly Roamer Traveling vendor, chauffeur, tour guide, renovator, and a master who keeps everyone fed. Da Pan hates down time. It makes him itch for some action.
details.matstats: OBJ Heavy Burden, Seeker of Dark Lung }}
